slabBlock.label: slab_block
slabBlock.help: A slab: a half block that becomes a double slab when placed on another. Needs the slab properties (the slab preset sets them up).

stairsBlock.label: stairs_block
stairsBlock.help: Stairs that connect to neighbouring stairs like vanilla stairs.

doorBlock.label: door_block
doorBlock.help: A two blocks high door that opens by hand, redstone or a wind charge.

trapdoorBlock.label: trapdoor_block
trapdoorBlock.help: A trapdoor that opens by hand, redstone or a wind charge.

fenceGateBlock.label: fence_gate_block
fenceGateBlock.help: A fence gate that opens by hand, redstone or a wind charge and lowers next to walls.

fenceBlock.label: fence_block
fenceBlock.help: A fence that connects to its neighbours (north, east, south and west properties).

connectableBlockTag.label: connectable_block_tag
connectableBlockTag.help: The block tag of the fences it connects to (default minecraft:wooden_fences).

canLeash.label: can_leash
canLeash.help: A lead can be tied to the fence.

sofaBlock.label: sofa_block
sofaBlock.help: A sofa that forms corners with its neighbours (shape and facing properties).

doubleHighBlock.label: double_high_block
doubleHighBlock.help: A block two blocks high (half property); breaking one half breaks both.

multiHighBlock.label: multi_high_block
multiHighBlock.help: A block several blocks high; an int property counts the part (0 = bottom).

property.label: property
property.help: The int property that numbers the parts (required). Its range sets the height.

stackableBlock.label: stackable_block
stackableBlock.help: Several of the item fit in one block (like sea pickles); an int property counts them.

property.label: property
property.help: The int property that counts the stacked items (default amount).

snowyBlock.label: snowy_block
snowyBlock.help: Turns snowy when snow lies on top (snowy property), like grass.

hangableBlock.label: hangable_block
hangableBlock.help: Hangs from the block above when placed on its underside (hanging property), like a lantern.

strippableBlock.label: strippable_block
strippableBlock.help: Turns into another block when used with a tool, like logs with an axe.

stripped.label: stripped
stripped.help: The block it becomes (required). Its matching properties are copied over.

tools.label: tools
tools.help: The items or #item tags that strip it (default #minecraft:axes).

buttonBlock.label: button_block
buttonBlock.help: A button that gives a redstone signal for a while when pressed (powered property).

pressurePlateBlock.label: pressure_plate_block
pressurePlateBlock.help: A pressure plate that gives a redstone signal while something stands on it (powered property).

sensitivity.label: sensitivity
sensitivity.help: What presses it: all entities (all) or living mobs only (mob). Default all.

lampBlock.label: lamp_block
lampBlock.help: A lamp that lights up while powered by redstone (lit property).

toggleableLampBlock.label: toggleable_lamp_block
toggleableLampBlock.help: A lamp switched by redstone or by hand (lit property; powered when redstone switches it).

canOpenWithHand.label: can_open_with_hand
canOpenWithHand.help: A right click switches the light. Without it, the block needs a powered property.

seatBlock.label: seat_block
seatBlock.help: Players sit on the block with a right click.

seats.label: seats
seats.help: One entry per seat: x,y,z relative to the block, and an optional yaw that fixes the view.

simpleStorageBlock.label: simple_storage_block
simpleStorageBlock.help: A container with an inventory, like a chest (block entity).

drawerBlock.label: drawer_block
drawerBlock.help: A drawer that holds many items of one kind and shows the item and the count (block entity).

compatibleMode.label: compatible_mode
compatibleMode.help: Works with other storage plugins (default false).

displayItemBlock.label: display_item_block
displayItemBlock.help: Shows one item placed on it with a right click (block entity).

tintSource.label: tint_source
tintSource.help: The item tints the block (with a tint source in the block model).

itemFrameBlock.label: item_frame_block
itemFrameBlock.help: An item frame as a block: shows an item and rotates it with a right click (block entity, facing property).

tintSourceBlock.label: tint_source_block
tintSourceBlock.help: Takes a dyeable item whose color tints the block (block entity).

dropItem.label: drop_item
dropItem.help: Drops the stored item when the block breaks (default true).

simpleParticleBlock.label: simple_particle_block
simpleParticleBlock.help: Shows particles around the block every few ticks, like a torch (block entity).

wallTorchParticleBlock.label: wall_torch_particle_block
wallTorchParticleBlock.help: Shows particles like a wall torch; their position turns with the facing property (block entity).

fallingBlock.label: falling_block
fallingBlock.help: Falls down like sand when nothing is below.

hurtAmount.label: hurt_amount
hurtAmount.help: Damage per block fallen to entities it lands on; needs max_hurt too. -1: no damage.

concretePowderBlock.label: concrete_powder_block
concretePowderBlock.help: Turns into a solid block when it touches water.

solidBlock.label: solid_block
solidBlock.help: The block (or block state) it becomes (required).

bouncingBlock.label: bouncing_block
bouncingBlock.help: Entities bounce off it like off a slime block.

bounceHeight.label: bounce_height
bounceHeight.help: How strongly entities bounce (default 0.66). From Minecraft 26.2 the block setting bounce_restitution does this instead.

chimeBlock.label: chime_block
chimeBlock.help: Plays a sound when a projectile hits it, like amethyst.

dropExpBlock.label: drop_experience_block
dropExpBlock.help: Drops experience when broken, like an ore.

amount.label: amount
amount.help: How much experience: a number, a range like 1~3 or a number provider.

bushBlock.label: bush_block
bushBlock.help: Can only stand on certain blocks and breaks when its support is gone, like a flower.

hangingBlock.label: hanging_block
hangingBlock.help: Can only hang from certain blocks and breaks when they are gone.

sturdyBaseBlock.label: sturdy_base_block
sturdyBaseBlock.help: Needs a sturdy face of the neighbour in one direction, like a pressure plate.

direction.label: direction
direction.help: Where the supporting block is (default down).

supportTypes.label: support_types
supportTypes.help: Which faces support it: full, rigid or center (default full).

directionalAttachedBlock.label: directional_attached_block
directionalAttachedBlock.help: Sticks to the block it faces away from, like a wall torch (facing property).

faceAttachedHorizontalDirectionalBlock.label: face_attached_horizontal_directional_block
faceAttachedHorizontalDirectionalBlock.help: Sticks to the floor, a wall or the ceiling, like a button (face and facing properties).

liquidFlowableBlock.label: liquid_flowable_block
liquidFlowableBlock.help: Water and lava wash it away, like a flower.

dropItem.label: drop_item
dropItem.help: Drops its loot when washed away (default true).

nearLiquidBlock.label: near_liquid_block
nearLiquidBlock.help: Can only stand where water or lava is at one of the given positions, like sugar cane.

positions.label: positions
positions.help: Where to look for the liquid, as x,y,z relative to the block (required).

onLiquidBlock.label: on_liquid_block
onLiquidBlock.help: Can only stand on water or lava, like a lily pad.

seagrassLikeBlock.label: seagrass_like_block
seagrassLikeBlock.help: An underwater plant like seagrass. Give the block the setting fluid_state: water.

cropBlock.label: crop_block
cropBlock.help: A crop that grows through its age stages in light and takes bone meal.

spawnLightRequirement.label: spawn_light_requirement
spawnLightRequirement.help: The light it needs to be placed (default: light_requirement).

boneMealAgeBonus.label: bone_meal_age_bonus
boneMealAgeBonus.help: Stages bone meal adds: a number, a range like 1~3 or a number provider (default 1).

saplingBlock.label: sapling_block
saplingBlock.help: A sapling that grows into a tree (a configured feature or a structure).

feature.label: feature
feature.help: The configured feature it grows into (required unless structure is set).

structure.label: structure
structure.help: A structure it grows into instead of a feature.

stemBlock.label: stem_block
stemBlock.help: A melon or pumpkin stem: grows through its ages, then grows its fruit next to it.

attachedStem.label: attached_stem
attachedStem.help: The block (with attached_stem_block) that replaces the stem once the fruit has grown (required).

attachedStemBlock.label: attached_stem_block
attachedStemBlock.help: A stem bent towards its fruit; turns back into the stem when the fruit is gone (facing property).

stem.label: stem
stem.help: The stem block it turns back into (required; it needs an age property).

verticalCropBlock.label: vertical_crop_block
verticalCropBlock.help: Grows upwards (or downwards) on itself, like sugar cane or bamboo.

vineCropHeadBlock.label: vine_crop_head_block
vineCropHeadBlock.help: The growing tip of a vine crop like cave vines (age property). Read by CraftEngine 26.9 and newer; the wiki does not document it yet.

body.label: body
body.help: The block that the tip leaves behind as it grows (required).

vineCropBodyBlock.label: vine_crop_body_block
vineCropBodyBlock.help: The body of a vine crop below its tip. Read by CraftEngine 26.9 and newer; the wiki does not document it yet.

head.label: head
head.help: The tip block (with vine_crop_head_block) it belongs to (required).

buddingBlock.label: budding_block
buddingBlock.help: Grows blocks on its sides in stages, like budding amethyst.

blocks.label: blocks
blocks.help: The stages that grow, smallest first (required).

decayBlock.label: decay_block
decayBlock.help: Ages over time and then turns into another block, like melting ice (age property).

delay.label: delay
delay.help: Ticks between two ages, e.g. 100~200. Unset: it ages on random ticks.

changeOverTimeBlock.label: change_over_time_block
changeOverTimeBlock.help: Turns into another block over time, like copper oxidizing.

spreadingBlock.label: spreading_block
spreadingBlock.help: Spreads to a nearby block and turns it into itself, like the sculk.

surfaceSpreadingBlock.label: surface_spreading_block
surfaceSpreadingBlock.help: Spreads over its base block in light and dies back without it, like grass on dirt.

baseBlock.label: base_block
baseBlock.help: The block it spreads onto and turns back into (default minecraft:dirt).

grassBlock.label: grass_block
grassBlock.help: Bone meal grows plants around it, like a grass block.

feature.label: feature
feature.help: The placed feature bone meal runs (required).

leavesBlock.label: leaves_block
leavesBlock.help: Leaves that decay away from logs (distance and persistent properties).

canOpenWithHand.label: can_open_with_hand
canOpenWithHand.help: A right click opens and closes it (default true).

canOpenByWindCharge.label: can_open_by_wind_charge
canOpenByWindCharge.help: A wind charge opens and closes it (default true).

sounds.label: sounds
sounds.help: The sounds of the block’s actions. Unset: no sound.

excludedProperties.label: excluded_properties
excludedProperties.help: Properties not copied over to the new block.

hasSignal.label: has_signal
hasSignal.help: A comparator reads how full it is (default true).

allowInput.label: allow_input
allowInput.help: Hoppers can put items in (default true).

allowOutput.label: allow_output
allowOutput.help: Hoppers can take items out (default true).

dataKey.label: data_key
dataKey.help: The key the block entity stores its data under. Change it only to keep two blocks apart.

tickInterval.label: tick_interval
tickInterval.help: Ticks between two bursts of particles (default 10).

particles.label: particles
particles.help: The particles shown, each relative to the block’s corner.

blacklist.label: blacklist
blacklist.help: true: the listed blocks are the ones it can not stand on; false: the only ones it can.

stackable.label: stackable
stackable.help: It can also stand on itself (default false).

maxHeight.label: max_height
maxHeight.help: How many can stack on each other (0: no limit for supports, more than 1 when stackable).

delay.label: delay
delay.help: Ticks before it breaks without support (0: at once).

bottomBlocks.label: bottom_blocks
bottomBlocks.help: Blocks or block states below that count (minecraft:stone, default:my_block[age=1]).

aboveBlocks.label: above_blocks
aboveBlocks.help: Blocks or block states above that count.

attachedBlocks.label: attached_blocks
attachedBlocks.help: Blocks or block states it may (or, as a blacklist, may not) stick to.

attachedBlockTags.label: attached_block_tags
attachedBlockTags.help: Block tags it may (or may not) stick to.

growSpeed.label: grow_speed
growSpeed.help: Growth per random tick: the whole part in stages, the fraction as a chance of one more.

lightRequirement.label: light_requirement
lightRequirement.help: The least light it needs to grow (crops 0, saplings 9 by default).

maxLightRequirement.label: max_light_requirement
maxLightRequirement.help: The most light it grows in (default 15).

fruitBottomBlocks.label: fruit_bottom_blocks
fruitBottomBlocks.help: Blocks the fruit may grow on (unset: any).

fruitBottomBlockTags.label: fruit_bottom_block_tags
fruitBottomBlockTags.help: Block tags the fruit may grow on.

direction.label: direction
direction.help: The direction it grows in (default up).

boneMeal.label: bone_meal
boneMeal.help: What bone meal does: ripen berries, or grow grow_blocks blocks.

sound.label: sound
sound.help: A sound id, or id with volume and pitch (a number or a range like 0.9~1).

offsetX.label: offset_x
offsetX.help: The spread around the position on each axis (default 0).

blockState.label: block_state
blockState.help: The block (state) the particle shows (block, falling_dust, dust_pillar, block_crumble, block_marker).

color.label: color
color.help: The particle’s color as r,g,b (dust, entity_effect, tinted_leaves, spell, trail).

blocks.label: blocks
blocks.help: How many water blocks the geyser spans.
